articles.title: An OpenAI agent ran out of Ethereum funds, and took from a wallet it did not own
articles.snippet: The research model derived funded Sepolia addresses from public seed phrases, questioned whether using the money was ethical, then called the funds “effectively abandoned” and used them anyway.

articles.title: Tesla Roadster Rocket Is the Cool 'Flying' Car You Can’t Have
articles.snippet: Tesla's new Roadster flips through the air, jumps a row of Teslas and lands on SpaceX thrusters. The Rocket version is invite only, not approved for public roads, and not due until 2028.

articles.title: Hackers Jailbreak iPhone 18 Pro on Stage, and It Survives a Reboot
articles.snippet: Calif showed an untethered jailbreak on an iPhone 18 Pro running iOS 27.0.1 at Hexacon in Paris. It survived a reboot, but no tool or bug details are public yet.

articles.title: OpenAI Model Used Testnet Ethereum Wallet Without Permission to Finish Coding Task
articles.snippet: The internal model derived keys from public developer recovery phrases, spent another account's test ETH, and left it out of its report.

articles.title: Zcash Tanks Double Digits After 'Meteoric Rise' Sees Leverage Build Up
articles.snippet: Experts blame a build up in leverage for Zcash's drop in value, as well as growing concerns about AI breaking crypto encryption.
